messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 1774502222 - elevated cross-region routing misses observed for eu-west -> apac (latency-based steering). Traffic spike + steering model drift detected. Failing % of requests: 8-12%. Service errors 502/504 up from 0.2% to 2.3%. Pager: @arjun

morgan: seeing same in dashboards, latency heatmap shows eu-west -> apac backends timing out around p95. Likely a weighting pivot that over-redirected to apac-1 which is partially degraded.

arjun: taking pager. oncall now. quick check: are any dedicated capacity nodes OOM-ing? @shira can you pull infra metrics?

shira: checking GPU/memory/az health now. apac-1 node pool shows elevated syscall wait and kernel context switches, but nodes still up. No OOMs. forwarding `dmesg` snippet to SRE channel.

arjun: ok. mitigation plan: 1) reduce steering weight to apac-1 to 5% 2) enable regional pin fallback to eu-west for 30m 3) increase routing policy TTL to avoid flapping. Who can run the route commands?

platform-oncall: I can run the policy change. running `routectl get-policy steering-eu-apac --json | jq .weights` to confirm.

platform-oncall: current weights: eu-west: 40, apac-1: 55, apac-2: 5

morgan: that apac-1 weight looks wrong given health. Was there a recent model retrain for latency steering?

arjun: yes, A/B rollout this morning. suspect sample bias in telemetry feeding the steering model. Rolling back to previous model would be safest if we had a clear cutoff.

shira: for now, I'll patch route: `routectl set-weight steering-eu-apac --backend apac-1=5 --backend eu-west=90 --backend apac-2=5 --reason "emergency reduce apac-1 due to elevated errors"`

platform-oncall: applied. Confirming traffic shift..

incident-bot: change applied by platform-oncall at 1774502287

eli: FYI a handful of customers in APAC reported timeouts around 10:40 UTC. Need to prepare a short note for statuspage. Any customer impact estimate?

morgan: initial estimate: roughly 1.8% of requests from regions using latency-steer, spike lasted ~12min before mitigation. we'll compute exact RPS and affected customers.

arjun: monitoring p50/p95/p99. p95 is dropping back toward baseline. errors trending down to 0.4%.

shira: infra logs show increased conn reset from apac-1 loadbalancer to backend pods. I'm opening a ticket with cloud provider for network path microbursts. Ticket ID: GCP-78923 (added to thread)

platform-oncall: I also toggled fallback policy: `routectl set-fallback steering-eu-apac --enable-pin eu-west --duration 30m` so new sessions should prefer eu-west.

morgan: can we block the telemetry source that caused the steering model to prefer apac-1? Need to prevent automated re-learn during incident.

arjun: good call. @platform-oncall disable steering retrain ingestion for steering-eu-apac stream.

platform-oncall: ingestion paused. command: `mlctl pause-stream steer-eu-apac-training` done at 1774502350

incident-bot: post-action summary: weight change, fallback pin enabled, retrain ingestion paused. Monitoring for 15m.

eli: drafting statuspage update: short summary + customer guidance. I'll post when we have numbers. Can ops provide estimated affected customers and duration?

morgan: pulling logs now. initial ballpark: ~210 unique orgs experienced at least one error, primarily medium-high throughput integrations. duration ~12-18m starting 1774502180.

arjun: agree. escalate to infra oncall for apac-1 network path investigation. @shira please lead.

shira: on it. I've attached a small packet capture and forwarded to provider. Also scaling apac-1 pod group down/up to clear potential kernel-level socket leak.

platform-oncall: scaled apac-1 pod replicas from 24 -> 12 -> 24 as a soft restart. no rollout traffic errors during scale. Provider acknowledged ticket and is investigating fabric microbursts.

incident-bot: telemetry: errors back to baseline at 1774502502. continued watch for 30m.

arjun: thanks everyone. I'll remain on thread for 30m. @eli can you post the status update: "Mitigated — steering weight rollback + fallback pinned to eu-west; provider investigating apac-1 network microbursts. Impact: transient errors for some APAC customers ~12-18m, now reduced." include contact for affected customers and link to ticket.

eli: posted on statuspage and tagged customers in affected list. :white_check_mark:

morgan: follow-up items: 1) revert steering model rollout pending investigation, 2) add telemetry bias checks to retrain pipeline, 3) postmortem with root cause and mitigations.

arjun: creating incident ticket and assigning to SRE/ML teams. Will run postmortem template after provider reply. Thanks all for quick handoff. closing paging for now, staying in channel until postmortem started.

platform-oncall: logging actions to changelog: weight-change, fallback-pin, retrain-pause, pod-scale. all timestamps added.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS -> mitigated; severity downgraded to SEV-3 at 1774502600. Closing active pager.

arjun: closing thread in 10m unless we see regressions. :thumbsup:
